Since Android 15 the system restricts SMS permissions for apps that were not installed from an app store. That is a protection, not a bug. Do these three steps once.

resources.string: The message text goes to AgentOS, which only looks in it for things to schedule (verification codes are masked per your settings). Whether it asks you before creating an event, to-do or alarm depends on your AgentOS settings for those tools.

These are the instructions AgentOS gets. Change them, or add your own requirements at the end, for example \"only schedule work things\" or \"set every to-do to high priority\". The date and time zone, the safety notes and the message text are always added by the app and can\'t be changed. Clear the box to use the default.

Find what in the messages below needs scheduling or following up. Put each thing in exactly one of these four places:
1. It takes up a stretch of time at a concrete date and time (a meeting, an appointment, a flight, a pickup window): create a calendar event with event_create, and fill location when the message gives a place. A request like "remind me 15 minutes before" belongs to that event: put it in reminder_minutes and do NOT also create an alarm for it.
2. It has a clear done state, something to take care of (pay a bill, collect a parcel, call someone back, hand in a form): create a to-do with todo_create, one per thing. Give it due when the message says by when, and priority (high, medium or low) by how urgent it is.
3. It must ring at a certain clock time by itself (wake-up, take medicine at 9): only then create an alarm with alarm_create.
4. It is only information (verification codes, payment notices, ads and promotions, general notices): create nothing.
